title: Home
tagline: Anya is asked to keep a secret that feels wrong.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Anya is 9. She loves playing in the park near her building.

nodes.speaker: vikram
nodes.text: Hey Anya! Here's a big chocolate for you. You're my special friend.

nodes.speaker: vikram
nodes.text: Let's play a secret game at my place. Never tell your parents, okay? Or you'll be in big trouble.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Anya's tummy feels funny. The 'secret game' makes her feel scared and confused.

choices.label: Keep the secret. She doesn't want to get in trouble.
Tell only her best friend Zoya.
Tell Mummy, even though she was told not to.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Anya keeps the secret. She feels worried every day and stops going to the park.

nodes.speaker: mitthu
nodes.text: Secrets that make you feel scared are never okay to keep. You won't get in trouble for telling. Try again!

nodes.speaker: zoya
nodes.text: That sounds scary, Anya. But I don't know what to do. I'm only 9 too!

nodes.speaker: mitthu
nodes.text: Telling a friend is a good start! But a trusted adult can keep you safe. Try again!

nodes.speaker: anya
nodes.text: Mummy, Vikram Bhaiya told me to keep a secret. It made me feel scared.

nodes.speaker: mummy
nodes.text: Thank you for telling me, Anya. You're so brave. This is NOT your fault, and you are not in trouble.

nodes.speaker: mummy
nodes.text: Grown-ups should never ask children to keep scary secrets. I'll keep you safe, and we'll get help.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Anya told a trusted adult. That is always the right thing to do.

card.title: Right to Be Safe
card.kid: Your body belongs to you. Nobody should touch you in a way that feels unsafe, or ask you to keep a scary secret. If it happens, tell a trusted adult. It is never your fault.
card.teen: The POCSO Act, 2012 protects every child under 18, girls and boys, from sexual abuse and harassment, including online. Special courts hear these cases, a child's identity must be kept secret, and the child's statement can be recorded at a place where they feel comfortable, with a trusted adult present.
card.ifItHappens: Tell a trusted adult right away, or call 1098 any time. It's free.
card.source: Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012 (Sections 23, 24, 28, 33)

game.title: Surprise or Unsafe Secret?
game.prompt: A surprise is fun and ends soon. An unsafe secret makes you feel scared. Sort each one.

items.text: "Don't tell Didi, we're planning her birthday party!"
items.explain: A surprise party ends with everyone happy. That's a fun surprise.

items.text: "Don't tell your parents I gave you this phone."
items.explain: An adult asking you to hide gifts from your parents is a warning sign.

items.text: "This is our special secret game. If you tell, you'll get in trouble."
items.explain: Threats to keep a secret mean you should tell a trusted adult right away.

items.text: "Let's hide Papa's Diwali gift until the big day."
items.explain: It's a surprise that will be shared soon. Totally fine!

items.text: "Send me a photo of yourself and don't tell anyone."
items.explain: Never send photos to someone who asks you to keep it secret. Tell an adult.

items.text: "Keep the cake hidden till Dadi comes home!"
items.explain: A happy surprise for Dadi. Nobody is scared or hurt.
